summary_1line: Janaka’s envoys reach Ayodhya and invite King Dasaratha to Mithila after Rama wins Sita by breaking the sacred bow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dusty messengers in swift chariots arrive exhausted at the grand gates of Ayodhya after three nights of hard travel.
Before the aged King Dasaratha in his palace hall, Janaka’s envoys bow and announce that Rama has broken the sacred bow and won Sita.
